evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Aligned language models fail under two independent pressures: the structural jailbreak class recently formalized as Involuntary In-Context Learning (IICL), which reframes a harmful request as the final missing cell of a data-labeling task completed by pattern rather than judged as content; and the erosion of safety alignment outside English.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using a deterministic IICL operator and a StrongREJECT-style rubric judge, we red-team two Google Gemini models on two benchmarks, a 30 general-harm behaviours from HarmBench and 30 financial-abuse behaviours from FinProof, each under a single-shot baseline and under IICL in four languages (English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic).

declaredVenue: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Pilot study. Includes a cross-family judge-agreement check (kappa=0.86) and output-language verification
